== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Geonosis: Separatist Council Room (Errata)]] (<code>1291_19</code>, Virtual Block 9.1), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee forum, “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post p890420 by Lukes Bionic Hand, 9 July 2014: https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p890420
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “'''Dark Side:''' May ▼ Gunray. While two senators here, they use their game text as if in a senate majority. '''Light Side:''' While Gunray or opponent's senator here, your spies may not deploy here.”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card, with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB9-p4-20-Geonosis_Separatist_Council_Room-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B41 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
